description: This file is a JUnit 5 test class for testing the BinaryStreamHandler component within the org.openmrs.obs package, focusing on its view support and data saving functionalities.

classes.name: BinaryStreamHandlerTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that verifies the behavior of BinaryStreamHandler, including supported views and saving observations with complex data.

methods.name: shouldReturnSupportedViews
methods.description: Asserts that the handler correctly returns the list of supported views.

methods.name: shouldSupportRawView
methods.description: Checks if the handler supports the RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: shouldNotSupportOtherViews
methods.description: Ensures that the handler does not support various other view types.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldRetrieveCorrectMimetype
methods.description: Tests saving complex data to Obs and verifies that the MIME type is correctly set.
